The food looks like cottage cheese in a bowl about 15 cm across. The cottage cheese itself covers roughly 10 to 11 cm and is mounded a few centimeters high.

A mound about 10 cm across and 4 cm tall holds about 150 to 200 mL. At roughly 1 g/mL, that is about 170 g.

Cottage cheese runs about 100 kcal per 100 g, or around 98 kcal/100 g for the 4% fat kind. So 170 g comes to about 170 kcal.
